metadata.evidence: - **Self-Consistency Chain-of-Thought (SC-CoT)**: An iterative process wherein the LLM generates plausible explanations supporting each proposed solution before settling on a final answer.
metadata.reason: Names one of the key prompt engineering methods supported by the framework.

metadata.evidence: - [**Medprompt**](https://github.com/microsoft/promptbase): A technique proposed by Microsoft, extending the traditional SC-COT.
metadata.reason: Names a prompt engineering strategy integrated into the artifact.

metadata.evidence: - **OM-ER (OpenMedprompt with Ensemble Refining)**: Leverages the diversity of multiple generated answers to produce a refined and more accurate final response.
metadata.reason: Names a novel prompt engineering method introduced in this framework.

metadata.evidence: - **OM-SR (OpenMedprompt with Self-reflection)**: This strategy employs a feedback loop to improve the generated answer.
metadata.reason: Names a self-reflection prompt engineering method implemented in the codebase.

metadata.evidence: We integrate attribute scores from ArmoRM-Llama3-8B, a reward model along with the critique model’s reflection as an external feedback to guide answer generation.
metadata.reason: Identifies the specific reward model integrated into the OM-SR strategy.

metadata.evidence: - [**VLLM**](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm): Fast Inference Very Large Language Model ibrary to facilitate rapid generation of responses in a efficient way.
metadata.reason: Specifies the fast inference library used by the framework.

metadata.evidence: - [**ChromaDB**](https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma):. Open-source embedding database, focused on the simplicity and efficiency. only dense vectors are allowed.
metadata.reason: Names a supported vector database integration for storing and searching dense embeddings.

metadata.evidence: - [**Qdrant**](https://qdrant.tech/): Embedding database focused on production-ready service with a convenient API.
metadata.reason: Names a supported vector database integration capable of handling sparse vectors.
